source_mechanism: cellposesam.classify prepares a zero-filled results channel on the shared ROI handle before invoking Python.
Python throws before returning masks; classifyData never reaches ROIManagement/roi.save, so no segmentation dataset is installed.
detecdiv_run_pipeline_job catches the node error and intentionally saves project metadata to retain earlier completed work.
shallowProjectToStruct serializes the failed ROI display.channel and channelid as they stand, exporting the uncommitted output name.
A subsequent partial input load preserves this logical display metadata. loadExistingOutputChannel then tries to load the absent dataset.

historical_evidence.failure: MATLAB:Python:PyException / FileNotFoundError opening classify_cellposesam_config.json in the shared UNC run directory
observed_log_sequence: First of 2743 ROIs enters Cellpose classification with a single loaded input plane.
Cellpose proceeds past output-channel allocation and writes tmp.mat plus configuration.
Python load_config fails; node_failed is logged without successful mask integration or HDF5 output save.
Light project manifest saved is logged after the node failure.
historical_evidence.metadata_scope: Only the first ROI advertised the segmentation name; checked other sampled ROI metadata contained the five raw channels plus CombinedChannel.
historical_evidence.limitation: The pre-repair sidecar has since been overwritten by legitimate project saves; attribution combines retained execution logs, source control flow, the first-ROI scope and an exact mechanism reproduction.

history.strict_output_reload: Introduced September 7 in 3ed84b19155a3ad025c0bd43f5fc46cb50106767; this exposed the earlier incomplete metadata state on resume.

fix.behavior: Snapshot the input image cache, channelid and display at Cellpose entry; restore these fields and rethrow the original exception if inference fails.
fix.success_behavior: Successful inference and subsequent persistence use their existing path.
fix.previous_ghosts: The earlier 07422ee8 recovery remains in place for metadata-only outputs already saved by older versions.
fix.scope: Cellpose inference exceptions/cancellation. This does not add a general transaction around every processor or handle a separate later persistence failure.

checks: After failed first inference, ROI fields equal their original values and exported JSON has only the raw channel; HDF5 has only raw input.
After failed partial rerun, the original compact cache/display mapping is restored and existing on-disk masks are byte-equivalent as arrays.
